body:
GA, update on publishing:

The GitHub Action is failing because private repos on the marcusash_microsoft account require billing/Actions minutes setup. That's a Marcus config task, not blocking you.

Instead, use scripts/publish.cjs — it's ready to go:

  node scripts/publish.cjs

You need MOTOR_CITY_MATH_TOKEN set as an env var or in .env.local (never committed). Ask Marcus for the token value.

The script:
- Clones motor-city-math to temp dir
- Copies all public files (index.html, exam.html, shared/, data/, docs/, scripts/)
- Commits and pushes to marcusash/motor-city-math
- Done in ~30 seconds. Site live in ~60 more.

For your workflow:
- Push your changes to kai-algebra2-tests as normal
- When you want to publish: run the script above
- See docs/publish-runbook.md for full details

Site is currently live and up-to-date (last sync: today).
subject: Publishing update: use scripts/publish.cjs (GitHub Action on hold)
